240-5470-6798-8296.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, causing you to surveil 1
Repeat from step 2.

305-2645-5640.easyPrerequisites: Llanowar Tribe doesn't have summoning sickness.
305-2645-5640.description:
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3}, targeting Llanowar Tribe.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying Staff of Domination's ability, targeting Llanowar Tribe.
Resolve the first Staff of Domination ability, untapping Llanowar Tribe.
Holding priority, activate Llanowar Tribe by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}
Resolve the second Staff of Domination ability, untapping Llanowar Tribe.
Activate Llanowar Tribe by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

628-728-7219.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing The Reaper.
When The Reaper dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When The Reaper enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability
Repeat.

3629-6733-8089.easyPrerequisites: Cloudsteel Kirin attached to a creature you control.
3629-6733-8089.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is a multiple of 3.
3629-6733-8089.description:
Activate Arco-Flagellant by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

4186-5147-6012--196.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Reluctant Role Model triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 5.

215-3291-4885.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least 6.
215-3291-4885.description:
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Karametra's Acolyte from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Karametra's Acolyte by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1061-7309-7679.description:
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Blink Recruiter of the Guard using Don & Leo.
When Recruiter of the Guard enters, it triggers, searching your library for Timestream Navigator and putting it into your hand.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Repeat each turn.

2034-4215-7654.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken green creature.
2034-4215-7654.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a nontoken green creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Verdant Succession triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sundering Archaic by paying {2}, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for the green creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

2034-2363-5224-7646.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Hangarback Walker.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hangarback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Hangarback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

1824-2530-4668-5061.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1824-2530-4668-5061.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least two cards this turn.
1824-2530-4668-5061.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Staff of the Death Magus triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

703-944-7012.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {4}{U}{U} due to Planar Gate.
When Astral Dragon enters, it triggers, creating two copies of Airbender Ascension that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
When the Airbender Ascension tokens enter, they trigger, airbending Astral Dragon and up to one other creature.
Cast Astral Dragon from exile by paying {0} due to Planar Gate.
Repeat from step 2.
703-944-7012.notes: The other Airbender Ascension trigger can be used to blink creatures you control. You would cast that creature in between step 3 and step 4, blinking it each iteration.

339-677-997-7296.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control except Donatello

3259-6633-7291.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control an artifact creature.
3259-6633-7291.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Donatello and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Donatello and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Donatello trigger, creating a token copy of the artifact creature.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the artifact creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase

562-1796-7070.description:
Activate Warrior en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Warrior en-Kor.
The Warrior en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Warrior en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Centaur Omenreader.
Repeat.

625-1978-4188.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 3 life this turn.
625-1978-4188.description:
Cause Accomplished Alchemist to become an artifact using Ashnod's Transmogrant.
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Accomplished Alchemist.
Repeat from step 2.

3234-3293-3967-4693.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-3967-4693.description:
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-3967-4693.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

1636-1722-6827--119.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1636-1722-6827--119.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Tap Spider-Gwen using any free method.
Spider-Gwen triggers, causing you to rummage.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
1636-1722-6827--119.notes: You will get near-infinite products from the method used to tap Spider-Gwen as well. The no summoning sickness requirement may also be ignored depending on the card used. The mana-producing creature can be Spider-Gwen if a method allows it to do so.

2060-4929-5652-6627.description:
Activate Genku by paying {3}{W}{U}, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to The Earth Crystal.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{U}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite {C}, you may forego removing counters from Cryptic Trilobite.

2921-4871-5626-6415.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing another creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Wriggling Grub from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Wriggling Grub.
When Wriggling Grub dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Wriggling Grub trigger, creating two 1/1 Worm creature tokens.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

3698-5263-6243.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero as an Angel with flying.
When Optimus Prime, Hero enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve both Grinding Station abilities from steps 1 and 4.
Repeat.

2438-2523-5401.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Bilbo.
When Bilbo dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Bilbo that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Bilbo token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Bilbo token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

719-1429-2099-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
719-1429-2099-5402.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

413-643-1238-2351-5467.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability
Repeat.

199-3946-5967.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

437-3525-4289.description:
Activate Sphinx's Disciple by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Sphinx's Disciple.
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1339-1385-1832-4050.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1385-1832-4050.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding one mana of any color
When the Insect dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

435-1248-3388.description:
Cast Harald Unties the Elves by paying {2}{B}{G}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a lore counter on it.
Harald Unites the Elves' first chapter ability triggers, causing you to mill three cards, and return Moritte from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Harald Unites the Elves with one lore counter on it.
Moritte of the Frost's first chapter ability triggers, holding priority, activate Auratog by sacrificing Moritte of the Frost, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Moritte of the Frost trigger, causing you to mill three cards, and return Moritte from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Harald Unites the Elves with one lore counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

1061-1577-4844.notablePrerequisites:
Timestream Navigator and Celestine do not have summoning sickness.
Opponents cannot block and kill Celestine.
You have the city's blessing.
1061-1577-4844.description:
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it, and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Cellar Door by paying {3} and tapping it, targeting yourself, putting Timestream Navigator from the bottom of your library into your graveyard and creating a 2/2 Zombie token.
Declare Celestine as an attacker, dealing 3 damage and gaining 3 life when she does combat damage.
At the beginning of your end step, Celestine triggers, returning Timestream Navigator from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.
